firstPlayerRule: Determine a first player randomly. That player takes the First Player marker.
clarifications: Starting with the player who has the First Player marker, players take turns clockwise.
At the end of each round, the First Player marker passes clockwise to the next player.
In a solo game, the Rival on your left takes the First Player marker. In a two-player game, House Hagal acts after each of the first player’s Agent turns.
